user.title: Add input color
user.description: Create a reusable color value. Pick a name and choose whether this color is a chromatic color or a white color (color temperature).

chromatic.title: Initial chromatic color
chromatic.description: Pick the starting color. You can change it later via the color.set_color service.

white.title: Initial color temperature
white.description: Pick the starting color temperature. You can change it later via the color.set_color service.

set_color.name: Set color
set_color.description: Set the stored color. Provide exactly one of hex, rgb, hs, xy, kelvin, or color name.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Optional brightness 0-255 stored alongside the color.

set_brightness.name: Set brightness
set_brightness.description: Set the stored brightness to a value 0-255.

clear_brightness.name: Clear brightness
clear_brightness.description: Clear the stored brightness so apply_to does not push a brightness value.

apply_to.name: Apply to lights
apply_to.description: Send the stored color to one or more light entities.

lights.name: Target lights
lights.description: Light entities to apply the color to.

override_brightness.name: Override brightness (use stored value)
override_brightness.description: If true and a brightness is stored, include it in the light.turn_on call. Ignored when the explicit brightness field is set.

brightness.name: Brightness (explicit)
brightness.description: Per-call brightness 0-255. Wins over override_brightness when set.
